- Please review the above bookings and provide corrected invoices or receipts.
- Clarify the billing logic for the flight fare and hotel surcharge to ensure future charges are accurate.
- Confirm whether any adjustments or refunds are required on my account.

I appreciate your prompt assistance in resolving these matters. If you need any additional information, such as screenshots of the booking confirmations or my corporate travel policy, please let me know.

Thank you for your attention to this issue.

Best regards,
